title: Home in Data science mode, calmer: tabs under the top bar, a smaller project picker beside the message box, fewer controls
request: Remove who drives and the budget; move the project picker and New project to the right of the chat box, smaller; move the Overview, Projects and Activity tabs under the top bar; remove two examples and the domain pack row; move the box a little down; placeholder one pixel smaller.
plan: Hide who drives, the budget and the domain pack in Data science mode only (Developer keeps the intern and its budget).
Delete the two examples from the page.
Reorder Home in Data science mode with CSS only: tabs first, the actions right-aligned above the box.
Check desktop, an open chat and phone width in the browser.

decisions.decision: Hide in Data science mode, never delete
decisions.why: the page's code reads the domain pack button, and Developer mode still needs the intern's controls

decisions.decision: Keep the picker small on phones too
decisions.why: a shared phone rule made it full width; a Data science phone rule keeps both buttons on one row

change: dclab_rnd/agentic/web/src/ds.css, dclab_rnd/agentic/web/src/views/home.html, rebuilt into static/app by make web.

findings.defect: On a phone the smaller project picker stretched across the whole width
findings.scenario: Data science mode at 375 px wide: the picker filled the row and New project dropped below it
findings.cause: the shared phone rule sets the picker to width 100%
findings.fix: a Data science phone rule keeps both buttons their own size on one row
findings.test: checked in the browser at 375 px: no sideways scroll, both buttons on one row

outcome: Home in Data science mode shows the heading, a small picker row and the message box with the six kinds of help and five examples; nothing was removed from Developer mode.
lessons: Moving a control in one look of the page needs a check at phone width, where shared rules can undo it.
risks: Starting the intern from Home now needs Developer mode.
